figurative_meaning_en: to decline or deteriorate, especially in character or quality
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার চরিত্রে ঘুণ ধরেছে, আর কেউ তাকে বিশ্বাস করে না।
এই সমাজে ধীরে ধীরে ঘুণ ধরা শুরু হয়েছে।
example_sentences_in_english: His character has been infested with worms; no one trusts him anymore.
This society is slowly starting to decay from within.
note: The idiom draws from the natural phenomenon of woodworms damaging wooden structures, symbolizing internal decay in human or societal contexts.
